skill_name: Write a list of questions that can help a customer diagnose a technical problem they're experiencing.
workflow: Are the printer cables connected securely? Is the printer receiving power? Is the printer has adequate ink and/or toner? Are there any error messages showing on the printer’s LCD display? What is the exact make and model of the printer? Is the printer driver software installed and up to date? Have you tried a hard reset of the printer? Have you tried printing a test page?
